testInventory.pins: The join panel mounts the "Co-op credential choice" region; opening or changing the choice mints nothing (zero fetch calls) and writes only the public choice key.

Join with primary mints POST /api/multiplayer/auth/token {password}; seat1/seat2 mint POST /api/multiplayer/auth/local-seats {action:"mint",seatId}; the choice grants no role or seat kind in any request or stored value.

Create-host mints through mintCoopCredential("primary") with exactly one /auth/token request and the same bearer/displayName/playerId reaching POST /api/multiplayer/matches; the host binding records choice primary.

OPERATOR_IDENTITY_REQUIRED drives the vault-identity error kind (link to vault settings) for create and join; OPERATOR_DENIED shows a wrong-password message with the generic kind; no server text is reflected.

LOCAL_SEAT_DENIED (401) and LOCAL_SEAT_THROTTLED (429, Retry-After shown) are distinct and sanitized; across 401, 429, 5xx and status 0 the mint fetch is called exactly once per explicit submit (no automatic retry).

Create and join password inputs are uncontrolled, unnamed type=password refs with autoComplete current-password; the value is cleared before the first await on success and on every error; the password never appears in React state, localStorage, sessionStorage or any URL.

A primary mint whose token is issued more than 10 s ahead of the browser clock is accepted and the create/join proceeds; the same token through seat1 is refused INVALID_TOKEN and no bearer is stored. Expiry, lifetime and agreement checks still refuse for both.

A successful join records the public binding {matchId, choice, playerId} and stores the per-match bearer through the existing bearer store; no password or private key is stored; a second join does not silently replace a different identity for the same match.
Primary host mint semantics stay unchanged: same create request shape, hostSeatKind spectator, host session creation and navigation.

Existing entry tests whose meaning changes are re-written first and must fail against the baseline product bytes for the right reason. The sizing draft fails 17 of the 24 existing tests (titles in draftRewriteSet) because the password inputs become uncontrolled refs and token errors become LocalSeatRequestError; the other 7 stay unchanged and passing.
Through the mounted LocalSeatOperatorPanel an unknown-outcome write (status 0 or 5xx) is followed by a seat refresh before any second write; the entry panel adds no path around that gating.

The chooser offers primary, local seat 1 and local seat 2, defaults to primary, persists the public choice only, and the availability refresh issues a GET only; an unprovisioned or revoked selected seat shows the operator-provision alert.
Storage failure shows a sanitized message; nothing mints; a bad stored value falls back to primary.
"Forget next-join choice" resets the choice to primary and does not remove any match bearer.

The disclosure states: choice grants no role; the computer operator can impersonate any local seat; re-provisioning creates a new identity needing GM readmission; revocation or re-provisioning stops the next mint or renewal while old bearers live to their original expiry (local seats at most one hour); old membership remains until the GM removes it. No immediate-eviction claim.

CoopCredentialRenewal renders nothing without a binding or when expiry is farther than the four-minute window; inside the window it shows the renewal prompt; after expiry it shows recovery; with fake timers advanced past expiry no fetch is made without an explicit submit.

Renewal mints with the JOINED choice, not the next-join choice; on success the bearer is replaced, the active transport for that match is closed and the page reloads; storage-only replacement is not accepted as renewal.

A renewal that returns a different playerId (re-provisioned seat) is refused: the bearer is unchanged, the transport is not closed, and the panel directs the operator to forget the sign-in and reclaim with the new password; no silent mid-session identity replacement.
Forget removes this match binding, bearer and choice, closes that match transport and navigates to /gameplay/campaigns; it revokes nothing on the server and removes no membership.
Renewal 401, 429 (Retry-After) and 5xx/status 0 show sanitized, distinct messages; exactly one request per explicit submit; the password is cleared before the await.

Two players plus a non-playing GM obtain three distinct public playerIds on one authority, stable across reload/reconnect, renewal and expired recovery; guest reclaim with a new password after re-provision: new playerId -> GM readmission -> ghost membership retained until ordinary removal.

CampaignNavigation mounts CoopCredentialRenewal for a host session (matchId) and a guest session (hostMatchId), and not for a non-co-op campaign, for each of the six surfaces (dashboard, missions, launch, starmap, log, personnel). CampaignNavigation.test.tsx is not edited.

CF-LSC2OP-7: after an unknown-outcome write (network/status 0 or server 5xx), refresh public seats before permitting any mutation resubmission. No blind replay or automatic write retry; failed refresh disables writes until explicit recovery. Both existing 409 codes retain refresh behavior and stable seat targeting.

CF-LSC2OP-3: distinguish not-revocable from generation-conflict in repository/service and expose sanitized NOT_REVOCABLE server code to the client.
